# UI UX Pro Max

$ARGUMENTS

Use this prompt for UI design, redesign, or UX improvement work.

## Design Flow

1. Identify page goal, user role, and primary action.
2. Select visual direction that matches IntellEvalPro branding.
3. Enforce mobile-first responsiveness from 390px.
4. Implement accessible interactions (focus states, contrast, labels).
5. Add meaningful motion only where it improves clarity.

## IntellEvalPro UI Constraints

- Tailwind + Flowbite component patterns.
- Role-aware color usage (superadmin/admin/guidance/dean/student).
- No horizontal overflow.
- Touch targets at least 44x44 on mobile.
- Keep visual consistency with existing navigation/components.
